parameters.jsCode:
const input = items[0]?.json || {};

return [
 {
   json: {
     ...input,
     m8_config: {
       service_name: 'DALIA_M8_Observability_Service_Lite',
       service_version: 'v1',

       contracts: {
         event_request_schema_version: 'dalia.m8.event_request.v1',
         log_result_schema_version: 'dalia.m8.log_result.v1'
       },

       storage: {
         provider: 'supabase',
         events_table: 'dalia_observability_events_lite'
       },

       defaults: {
         business_id: 'business_demo',
         environment: 'demo',
         status: 'success',
         level: 'INFO',
         latency_ms: 0
       },

       allowed_statuses: [
         'success',
         'warning',
         'error'
       ],

       allowed_levels: [
         'DEBUG',
         'INFO',
         'WARN',
         'ERROR'
       ],

       allowed_event_types: [
         'conversation',
         'decision',
         'advisor',
         'catalog',
         'commerce',
         'handoff',
         'messaging',
         'memory',
         'system',
         'error'
       ],

       key_events: [
         'message_received',
         'message_normalized',
         'intent_classified',
         'response_generated',
         'product_recommended',
         'message_sent',
         'image_sent',
         'purchase_started',
         'payment_pending',
         'order_confirmed',
         'shipment_created',
         'handoff_triggered',
         'handoff_human_notified',
         'customer_memory_stored',
         'customer_memory_retrieved',
         'customer_memory_skipped',
         'customer_memory_error',
         'error'
       ],

       correlation_policy: {
         require_event_id: true,
         preserve_conversation_id: true,
         preserve_session_id: true,
         preserve_user_id: true,
         preserve_transaction_id_when_available: true,
         preserve_handoff_id_when_available: true
       },

       error_policy: {
         never_block_main_flow: true,
         log_invalid_events_as_warning: true,
         default_error_event_name: 'error',
         default_error_type: 'error'
       }
     }
   }
 }
];
